operations.summary: Read finalized realtime facts for the authenticated tenant
operations.description: Tenant scope is derived exclusively from the authenticated identity. tenant_id is rejected. With query_version=2 the exact minute-aligned [from,to) interval is not rounded; without it, legacy hour alignment and original response keys apply. Missing or unfinalized evidence for any enclosing full UTC hour fails closed; zero traffic is returned only with complete source coverage.

params.name: from
params.description: Inclusive RFC3339 instant, exactly minute aligned after UTC normalization with query_version=2, otherwise hour aligned; never silently rounded.

params.name: to
params.description: Exclusive RFC3339 instant, exactly minute aligned after UTC normalization with query_version=2, otherwise hour aligned; later than from and no more than 31 days apart.

params.name: query_version
params.description: Explicit opt-in to minute queries and extended series/evidence. 3 adds coverage fields and returns settled hours when other enclosing hours are not finalized yet (coverage_complete=false, missing_windows lists the excluded hour starts) instead of 503. 4 is the realtime monitor: it reads every fact ingested so far, the unsettled current hour included, with no settlement reconciliation (coverage_complete=true, expected_events=0, finalized_through and source_watermark at the Unix epoch); it is a display read and never feeds billing. Omit for the legacy hour-aligned response; other values, empty or repeated values are rejected.

params.name: host
params.description: One or more canonical lowercase hosts without trailing dots, separated by single spaces.

params.name: listen_port
params.description: Exact production listen port. Omit to include legacy port-zero facts.

responses.description: Finalized atomic site realtime facts and source reconciliation evidence.
